answer: The orchard graph is validated at intake and the relic frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and walnut anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Forging one identity takes 13 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 719 takes that multiplied out, plus 357 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
